# "Turn the Current Around": St. Veldra Reads the President's First Speech

President Vento's promise to reverse the "upward flow" of wealth drew the loudest applause of the afternoon in Plateau Square and the quietest response on the trading floors of St. Veldra, where several desks were observed to stop taking calls for the duration of the address. Senior figures in the Capital Party declined to comment on the record. Off the record, one described the line as "a fine sentiment for a balcony and an expensive one for a budget". The Ledger notes that the President has not yet named the current, nor the turbine.
